data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display circular profile avatars with borders, overlays, and initials.
data.what_it_does: CircularProfileAvatar provides an alternative to Flutter's standard CircleAvatar widget. It allows developers to easily implement circular profile pictures with customizable borders, elevation, background and foreground overlays, initials text, and caching via cached_network_image.
use_when: You need a circular profile image with built-in border and elevation support.
You want to automatically fallback to initials text when the image URL is empty.
You require caching for network-based avatar images.
avoid_when: You are already using custom implementations of CircleAvatar and do not need extra features like built-in caching or text initials overlays.
strengths: Supports network image caching out of the box using cached_network_image.
Allows custom child widgets such as AssetImages or Flutter logos.
Easily configurable borders, elevation, and initials text.
weaknesses: Relies on older cached_network_image integration which may lack the latest caching configurations.
